problems_addressed.solution_summary: Return to the fundamentals and prioritize self-care and personal values over constant work demands.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Lack of boundaries leading to burnout
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Audit your calendar to ensure personal time and self-care are prioritized before work commitments.

episode_summary: In this episode, Paul Salter discusses the dangers of constant availability in real estate and the importance of balancing intensity with consistency for sustainable success. He emphasizes the need to return to fundamentals and prioritize self-care, using intentional limitations to drive innovation and creativity. Salter provides actionable advice on auditing your calendar to align personal and professional priorities, ensuring long-term success without burnout.
